metric.description: Hectares of additional woody cover inside the parcel, derived from ΔNDVI through a versioned index→cover transfer, difference-in-differences against the far control ring, leakage-deducted, reported at the lower confidence bound.

dnToReflectance.note: Earth Search v1 sentinel-2-l2a COGs are BOA-offset-harmonised (verified empirically 2026-09-10: red p50 ≈ 0.036, NIR p50 ≈ 0.37 over vegetation). The STAC raster:bands offset of -0.1 is recorded per scene but not applied.

modelTransfer.source: Provisional linear NDVI→fractional woody cover transfer for temperate riparian vegetation; to be calibrated against Tier 1 crown detections in production. Value and sd are placeholders pending approval.

provisional.note: Recommended metric implemented as the default; settled metric awaits approval.
300 m near ring and 800–1500 m far ring are placeholders; displacement distance for this landscape not yet approved.
Slope-interaction OLS with alpha 0.10 and 0.03 NDVI/yr is a placeholder criterion.
Index→cover transfer coefficient is a placeholder and dominates hectare-scale uncertainty.

Adding a far-ring residual draw per bootstrap iteration is the prototype's representation of control-matching error. Without it, placebo coverage on the Kootenay snapshot was 0.33 against a nominal 0.95. Method awaits approval.
